Study catalog

Source: vignettes/articles/studies.Rmd
studies.Rmd

Version française

Every study that qesR can load, with what qesR pins for it: the deposit and its version, the data file and its md5 checksum, and the documents. This page is generated when the site is built, from the catalog that ships with the package (inst/extdata/catalog/), the same data as qes_studies() and qes_docs(). None of it is copied by hand.

Code Year Family Study (DOI) Design Population n Licence Offline codebook
qes2022 2022 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2022 Pre- and post-election waves Canadian citizens aged 18+ residing in Quebec (online panel) 1,521 CC BY-NC 4.0 yes
qes2018 2018 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2018 Post-election cross-section Quebec population aged 16 and over 3,072 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2018_panel 2018 Durand election panel survey Panel Survey on the 2018 Quebec Election Panel Quebec adult population 1,250 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2014 2014 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2014 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 1,517 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2012 2012 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2012 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 1,505 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2012_panel 2012 Durand election panel survey Panel Survey on the 2012 Quebec Election Panel Quebec adult population 844 CC0 1.0 yes
qes_crop_2007_2010 2007-2010 CROP vote-intention polls CROP Polls on Quebec Provincial Vote Intentions, 2007-2010 Pooled polls Quebec adult population 24,027 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2008 2008 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2008 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 1,151 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2007 2007 Quebec Election Study Quebec Election Study 2007 Post-election cross-section Quebec adult population 2,175 CC0 1.0 yes
qes2007_panel 2007 Durand election panel survey Panel Survey on the 2007 Quebec Election Panel Quebec adult population 2,442 CC0 1.0 yes
qes1998 1998 1998 election polls 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP-CREATEC Panel Panel Francophone adult population of Quebec 1,483 CC0 1.0 yes
qes1998_crop 1998 1998 election polls 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP Panel Quebec adults interviewed in French 450 CC0 1.0 yes
qes1998_createc 1998 1998 election polls 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CREATEC Panel Quebec adults whose mother tongue is French 1,057 CC0 1.0 yes

n is the number of rows in the pinned data file. Studies of the families Durand election panel survey, CROP vote-intention polls and 1998 election polls are not Quebec Election Studies: they are listed under their own titles, and their designs and populations differ, so check both before comparing studies. Codes sharing one deposit: qes1998, qes1998_crop and qes1998_createc. Studies not in the public domain: qes2022 (CC BY-NC 4.0); the metadata qesR ships for them keeps their licence (the file COPYRIGHTS of the package lists it). Studies whose metadata qesR does not ship: none.

By study

The Deposit line links to the deposit’s DOI. The document links download the file from Dataverse; qes_download() saves them, md5-checked, in a folder you choose.

qes2022: Quebec Election Study 2022

  • Study: Quebec Election Study; Pre- and post-election waves; Canadian citizens aged 18+ residing in Quebec (online panel)
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.7910/DVN/PAQBDR, Harvard Dataverse, version 1.1; licence Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0 (CC BY-NC 4.0)
  • Pinned data file: 2022 Quebec Election Study v1.dta (Stata data file), 1,521 rows × 718 columns, md5 c51bafed57776ffa8d4c6f301f5c945b
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search()), under the study’s licence
  • Note: Two waves: campaign period (1,521 valid) and post-election recontact (1,220 kept), per the codebook’s methodological note. Licensed CC BY-NC 4.0.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2022")):
    • 2022 Quebec Election Study Codebook v1.pdf: Codebook, English, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2022")

  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP3/NWTGWS, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Pinned data file: Quebec Election Study 2018.dta (Stata data file), 3,072 rows × 254 columns, md5 d24f5b0be727d688ad305b8eb61f0d30
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: Online post-election survey. Includes 251 respondents aged 16-17 (deposit note).
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes2018")):
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 EN.doc: Questionnaire, English, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 FR.doc: Questionnaire, French, DOC
    • Quebec Election Study 2018 FR with programmed answer values.docx: Codebook, French, DOCX
    • Rapport méthodologique de l’Étude électorale québécoise 2018: Methodological report, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes2018")

qes1998: 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP-CREATEC Panel

  • Study: 1998 election polls; Panel; Francophone adult population of Quebec
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/QFUAWG, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Pinned data file: Total_panel_election_QC1998.sav (SPSS system file), 1,483 rows × 42 columns, md5 a2a2b2fef6a2edb202beae0e63e59f0c
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: The panel file combining the CROP and CREATEC polls (1,483 valid questionnaires), each with a pre- and a post-election wave by telephone. Francophones only: the codebook says it was decided to keep only francophones (« retenir uniquement les francophones »); the exact definition used for the pooled file is pending. Not a Quebec Election Study.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes1998")):
    • LivredeCodes_Panel_QC1998.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes1998")

qes1998_crop: 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CROP

  • Study: 1998 election polls; Panel; Quebec adults interviewed in French
  • Deposit: https://doi.org/10.5683/SP2/QFUAWG, Borealis, version 1.0; licence Public domain dedication (CC0 1.0)
  • Pinned data file: Total_sondages_election_CROP1998.sav (SPSS system file), 450 rows × 37 columns, md5 ceec0332eaa0eab117e4bcf5c4d8d672
  • Offline codebook: yes, shipped with qesR (qes_codebook(), qes_search())
  • Note: CROP file: pre-election poll of 450 respondents interviewed in French and its post-election wave, which kept only respondents whose language of use is French (N=426), per the codebook description. Undecided respondents, those who said they would spoil their ballot and those who refused to reveal their vote were oversampled.
  • Documents (qes_docs("qes1998_crop")):
    • LivredeCodes_CROP_1998.pdf: Codebook, French, PDF
  • Cite: qes_cite("qes1998_crop")

qes1998_createc: 1998 Quebec General Election Polls: CREATEC

  • Pinned data file: Total_sondages_election_CREATEC1998.sav (SPSS system file), 1,057 rows × 49 columns, md5 1aba610f71f1b5c46e03da2036e83330

  • Note: CREATEC file: telephone pre-election poll of 1,057 respondents whose mother tongue is French and its post-election wave; undecided and refusing respondents were oversampled. The deposit recommends the weight ponderc (codebook and file descriptions).

  • Cite: qes_cite("qes1998_createc")
